1.normal: the Unit I cutoff slider alone

2.normal: the Unit II cutoff slider alone

comment: No source is published. The module carries a ninth parameter, Volume, configured 0 to 1 with a default of 0.8 - and it has no ParamWidget on the panel and is never read in process, so it can be neither turned nor heard. It gets no line here because no click can reach it. Both filter type switches default to VCA, the middle of their three settings, so a freshly placed K108 filters nothing. The cutoff parameters are configured with a display base of 1000 and a multiplier of 20, which is 20Hz to 20000Hz; a cutoff CV of one volt moves the parameter a tenth of its travel, and a tenth of three decades is 0.997 of an octave, so those jacks are within a third of a per cent of 1V per octave and are coloured as pitch. The resonance CV jack is shared: one voltage is added to BOTH filters' resonance parameters. Process returns 0V immediately when the audio input has no cable. The filter models are named Ladder and Biquad in configSwitch, at values 0 and 1; the panel prints them in Japanese under the English heading FILTER I TYPE, while the low pass, high pass and VCA switch is the one the maker's tooltip calls Filter A Type.
